entities.summary: Estádio Mario Celso Petraglia locally known as Arena da Baixada, is a stadium located in Curitiba, the state capital of Paraná, Brazil. It is the home stadium of Club Athletico Paranaense, and has a capacity of 42,372 people. The stadium was the first in Brazil to sell its naming rights; it was known as Kyocera Arena between 2005 and 1 April 2008 and Ligga Arena between June 2023 and August 2025. It was the first retractable roof stadium built in South America.
